dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『やっぱりここに居たんだね』
なぜか、居るんだ。

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『転校、するんだってね……びっくりしたよ』
dialogues.en:
""I heard you're transferring schools. It was a surprise. I
didn't know that.""
dialogues.text:
""I heard you're transferring schools. It was a surprise. I
didn't know that.""

dialogues.jp: 夕暮れの学校の屋上を映すテレビ。
dialogues.en:
The TV was showing the rooftop of the school building at
dusk.
dialogues.text:
The TV was showing the rooftop of the school building at
dusk.

dialogues.jp: ああ、俺もびっくりしてるさ。

あの日……さくらにおかしなことを言われた日
に放送していた例のドラマをビデオに録画した
ものだが……。
dialogues.en: We're watching the soap opera Nemu called to ask me to tape.
dialogues.text: We're watching the soap opera Nemu called to ask me to tape.

dialogues.jp:
そんな気になる内容よりも、隣に座る音夢のほ
うがよほど気になって仕方ない。
dialogues.en:
I'm more concerned about Nemu who's sitting next to me than
the content of the soap opera.
dialogues.text:
I'm more concerned about Nemu who's sitting next to me than
the content of the soap opera.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか面白くなさそうなのに、じ〜っとテレ
ビを見つめている。
dialogues.en: She's staring at the TV like she isn't enjoying it.
dialogues.text: She's staring at the TV like she isn't enjoying it.

dialogues.jp:
先ほどから、無い知恵を雑巾のように絞ってい
るのだが、この状況がなんなのか見当がつかな
い。
dialogues.en:
I'm thinking as hard as I can, but I have no idea about the
situation we're in.
dialogues.text:
I'm thinking as hard as I can, but I have no idea about the
situation we're in.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、死刑囚の最後の夕食はやたら豪勢に
なるとかなんとかの不吉な話を連想してしまう
……。
dialogues.en:
I kept thinking about the way a death row prisoner's last
dinner is sumptuous, or something like that......
dialogues.text:
I kept thinking about the way a death row prisoner's last
dinner is sumptuous, or something like that......

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『ただ、僕は思い出になりたくなかったんだ』
dialogues.en: ""I didn't want to become a memory.""
dialogues.text: ""I didn't want to become a memory.""

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『どうせ消えてしまう人間だからね……』
dialogues.en: ""I'm doomed to disappear from your life......""
dialogues.text: ""I'm doomed to disappear from your life......""

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp:
「音夢様……あの、これ、どんな話でしたっ
　け？」

今だけは、尊敬語と謙譲語を極められそうなほ
ど、勢いよくへりくだってしまう。
dialogues.en: I'm being as polite as possible.
dialogues.text: I'm being as polite as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「本当は死んでいる神谷くんが、好きだった女
　の子の悩みを知って姿を見せてるって話」
dialogues.en:
"That guy's already dead, but he finds out about the problem
she has and he decides to come back to help her because he
likes her."
dialogues.text:
"That guy's already dead, but he finds out about the problem
she has and he decides to come back to help her because he
likes her."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから想い出になりたくないって……」
dialogues.en: "That's why he said he doesn't want to be a memory."
dialogues.text: "That's why he said he doesn't want to be a memory."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふぅん。意外とファンタジーな話だな」

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『もう時間がない……』
男の子役が夕焼けに染まる空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: The actor looked up at the sky at sunset.
dialogues.text: The actor looked up at the sky at sunset.

dialogues.jp: 確かに時間が迫っている。
dialogues.en: He really didn't have much time left.
dialogues.text: He really didn't have much time left.

dialogues.jp:
１時間と区切られたドラマは、すでにラスト１
０分を切っているはずだ。
dialogues.en:
The soap opera's one hour long, and we've less than ten
minutes to go.
dialogues.text:
The soap opera's one hour long, and we've less than ten
minutes to go.

dialogues.jp:
テレビの話ってのは、どうしても残り時間で展
開が読めてしまうのが悩みものだ。
dialogues.en:
It's too bad that you can guess pretty much all of the story
at the end of the show.
dialogues.text:
It's too bad that you can guess pretty much all of the story
at the end of the show.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、ここから話が大きく変化することは
ないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure they can't extend the story too much more from
here.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure they can't extend the story too much more from
here.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてかな」
余計なことを考える俺の隣で、音夢が呟く。
dialogues.en:
Nemu mumbles next to me as I was thinking about something
else.
dialogues.text:
Nemu mumbles next to me as I was thinking about something
else.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「前は泣きながら見てたのに……今は｛うらや／羨｝ましい」
dialogues.en: "I used to watch this crying, but I'm just envious now."
dialogues.text: "I used to watch this crying, but I'm just envious now."

dialogues.jp: 視線を音夢の横顔から、テレビに戻す。
dialogues.en: I looked back at the TV.
dialogues.text: I looked back at the TV.

dialogues.jp: 「羨ましい……」
羨ましいのかそれって？

なんだか会話の歯車がかみ合わなくて、ため息
しか出ない。
dialogues.en: I don't know what she's talking about and I can only sigh.
dialogues.text: I don't know what she's talking about and I can only sigh.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ調子悪いのか音夢？」
開き直っていつもの口調に戻る。
dialogues.en: I decided to be open about it and try to act natural.
dialogues.text: I decided to be open about it and try to act natural.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あん？」

自分で話を振っておいて、思わずおかしな反応
をしてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I know it was a bad response since I started up the
conversation.
dialogues.text:
I know it was a bad response since I started up the
conversation.

dialogues.jp:
少し前は、無視されるか、つっけんどんに答
えられるだけだったのに素の反応が返ってき
た……。
dialogues.en:
She used to ignore me or be blunt when I talk to her a while
ago. But now, she's starting to talk to me......
dialogues.text:
She used to ignore me or be blunt when I talk to her a while
ago. But now, she's starting to talk to me......

dialogues.jp:
「いや、まだ卒業パーティーやってるのに、急
　に帰ってきたからさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, because you suddenly came home in the middle of the
graduation after party."
dialogues.text:
"Well, because you suddenly came home in the middle of the
graduation after party."

dialogues.jp:
「しかも、挨拶もなしにいきなり、一緒にビ
　デオを見ろとか言い出すし……熱でもある
　のか？」
dialogues.en:
"Then you told me to watch a video with you...... Do you
have a fever?"
dialogues.text:
"Then you told me to watch a video with you...... Do you
have a fever?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……いや、ちょっと熱いかな」
胸元に握りこぶしを当てて、音夢が呟く。
dialogues.en: Nemu mumbled, placing her fist over her chest.
dialogues.text: Nemu mumbled, placing her fist over her chest.

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『出来れば神谷くんの口から聞きたかったな』
dialogues.en: ""I wanted to hear it from you.""
dialogues.text: ""I wanted to hear it from you.""

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『……ごめん』

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『ううん。いいの。楽しかったよ』
潤んだ瞳に、思わずドキリとしてしまう。
dialogues.en: My heart raced to see her teary eyes.
dialogues.text: My heart raced to see her teary eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「ね、熱があるって大丈夫か？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だよ……もう大丈夫」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、そうか」
なんだかおかしい。

舌が回らないし、最近よくある不思議な｛どうき／動悸｝に
見舞われる。
dialogues.en:
I was stuttering and my heart was racing, like had been
happening a lot recently.
dialogues.text:
I was stuttering and my heart was racing, like had been
happening a lot recently.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、どうしてこのドラマ録画してるんだ？
　月曜には家にいたじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"But why did you tape this soap opera? I thought you were
home on Monday."
dialogues.text:
"But why did you tape this soap opera? I thought you were
home on Monday."

dialogues.jp: 目を逸らすいいわけのように、テレビを示す。
dialogues.en: I pointed at the TV trying to look away from Nemu.
dialogues.text: I pointed at the TV trying to look away from Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんのせいです」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんに会っちゃうかも知れないから、ここ
　に下りて来れなかったんだもん」
dialogues.en: "I couldn't come downstairs because I might see you."
dialogues.text: "I couldn't come downstairs because I might see you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「すまん……って、それ俺のせいか！？」
頭を下げかけて慌てて首を振る。
dialogues.en: I shook my head as soon as I caught myself nodding.
dialogues.text: I shook my head as soon as I caught myself nodding.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前じゃないの……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どこが当たり前なんだよ……」

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『でも……ごめん』

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『謝らないでよ』

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp:
『……謝らないで。お願い……ね、あなたの記
　憶の中で、笑顔のままでいさせて欲しいから』
dialogues.en:
""Don't apologize, please. I want to be smiling in your
memory.""
dialogues.text:
""Don't apologize, please. I want to be smiling in your
memory.""

dialogues.jp: なんか無性にむかつく……。

穏便に行こうと思ってたのに、思わず｛にら／睨｝み返し
てしまう。
dialogues.en: I thought I should take it easy but I stared back at her.
dialogues.text: I thought I should take it easy but I stared back at her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それは……全部兄さんがいけないんだよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんだそりゃ？　ガキかお前は。美春並みの
　理屈だぞそれ」
dialogues.en: "What's that? Are you a kid? You sound just like Miharu."
dialogues.text: "What's that? Are you a kid? You sound just like Miharu."

dialogues.jp: 言葉と違って、どうにも表情がゆるんでしまう。
dialogues.en: I couldn't keep a straight face as I talked.
dialogues.text: I couldn't keep a straight face as I talked.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「美春並みってなによ！？　わ、私が子供だっ
　たら同い年の兄さんだって子供じゃないの！」
dialogues.en:
"What about Miharu? If I'm a kid, then you must be a kid
too, since we're the same age."
dialogues.text:
"What about Miharu? If I'm a kid, then you must be a kid
too, since we're the same age."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ふっ、年は関係ないだろうが。俺が悪いんだっ
　たら理由を言ってみろ」
dialogues.en:
"It's not about your age. Give me some reasons to prove that
it's my fault."
dialogues.text:
"It's not about your age. Give me some reasons to prove that
it's my fault."

dialogues.jp: 肩をすくめて、やれやれ、と首を振る。
dialogues.en: I shrugged my shoulders and shook my head.
dialogues.text: I shrugged my shoulders and shook my head.

dialogues.jp: うつむく。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんが……私の兄さんだから……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「バカ……大バカ兄さん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのなぁ」

人を避けたり、元気になったり、急にまた落ち
込んだり……。
dialogues.en:
She avoids me, then she's fine, and then she's sad
again......
dialogues.text:
She avoids me, then she's fine, and then she's sad
again......

dialogues.jp: 「お前、本当に熱でもあるんじゃないのか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……あるよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　なんだその反応は……ちょっと顔見せ
　てみろ」
顔を覗き込もうとする。
dialogues.en: I try to look into her face.
dialogues.text: I try to look into her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも……兄さんこそ頬が赤いよ」
すっ、と音夢の手が頬に寄せられる。
dialogues.en: Nemu placed her hands over my cheeks.
dialogues.text: Nemu placed her hands over my cheeks.

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『記憶に残る顔、か……』
dialogues.en: ""The face you want me to remember......""
dialogues.text: ""The face you want me to remember......""

dialogues.jp: 足音。

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『……どうしたの？』

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp:
『いや……君の笑顔って、そんなんじゃないん
　だ』

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『えっ？』

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp:
『僕が覚えていなくちゃいけない君の顔って、
　嘘の――無理して浮かべた笑顔でいいの？』
dialogues.en: ""Do you want me to remember a fake smile?""
dialogues.text: ""Do you want me to remember a fake smile?""

dialogues.jp: 女子学生の頬に、そっと手が寄せられる。
dialogues.en: He touched the girl's cheek with his hand.
dialogues.text: He touched the girl's cheek with his hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「テレビってずるいんだよ……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「義理の兄妹とか、死に別れた恋人とか……絶
　対に駄目だって恋が叶っちゃうの……」
dialogues.en:
"They all fulfill their love...... like the stepbrother and
sister or the dead lover... It's just not possible in real
life."
dialogues.text:
"They all fulfill their love...... like the stepbrother and
sister or the dead lover... It's just not possible in real
life."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「憧れちゃうよね……自分と重なれば重なるほ
　ど。ハッピーエンドなほど……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm more envious if it overlaps with me, and when they get
happy."
dialogues.text:
"I'm more envious if it overlaps with me, and when they get
happy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……作り物の、話だからな」

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 『……神谷くん』

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp:
『大丈夫だよ。今日が終わっても、別れがあっ
　ても――また明日がある。また会える』
dialogues.en: ""Don't worry. No matter what happens, we can meet again.""
dialogues.text: ""Don't worry. No matter what happens, we can meet again.""

dialogues.jp: それは、音夢がいつも言っている言葉だった。
dialogues.en: Nemu says that all the time.
dialogues.text: Nemu says that all the time.

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp:
『……嘘つき……そんなやさしい嘘つかないで
　よ』
dialogues.en: ""Liar. I know you're just saying that.""
dialogues.text: ""Liar. I know you're just saying that.""

dialogues.jp: お互いに見つめあったまま動かない。
dialogues.en: They looked at each other standing still.
dialogues.text: They looked at each other standing still.

dialogues.jp: 動けない。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……私、本当はこの話嫌いなんだ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「消えちゃうの知ってるのに、彼女の思い出に
　なれればいいってずるいもん……女の子が可
　哀想だよ」
dialogues.en:
"He knows he can't stay but he still wants to be part of her
memory. That's not fair for the girl."
dialogues.text:
"He knows he can't stay but he still wants to be part of her
memory. That's not fair for the girl."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「女の子の気持ちなんて全然考えてない……男
　の人の書いた、都合のいい話だって」
dialogues.en:
"Whoever wrote this story must be a guy, because it isn't
thinking about how this girl feels."
dialogues.text:
"Whoever wrote this story must be a guy, because it isn't
thinking about how this girl feels."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でもね……今は少しだけ分かる気がするの」
dialogues.en: "But I think I understand better now."
dialogues.text: "But I think I understand better now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私、子供だから……バカで、素直で、自分の
　心にだけ正直でいいかなって……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm still a kid...... stupid and honest, and I should be
more honest and follow my heart."
dialogues.text:
"I'm still a kid...... stupid and honest, and I should be
more honest and follow my heart."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「思うの――」

唇を触れ合わせるだけの、可笑しなくらい子供っ
ぽいキスなのに……。
dialogues.en:
The kiss was just putting our lips together and that was
all. Such a childish kiss.
dialogues.text:
The kiss was just putting our lips together and that was
all. Such a childish kiss.

dialogues.jp: ふたりともぎこちなくお互いを抱きしめている。
離れてしまうとぬくもりが消えてしまいそうで。
dialogues.en:
We were afraid that the warmth of the other would be lost
forever if we let go of each other.
dialogues.text:
We were afraid that the warmth of the other would be lost
forever if we let go of each other.

dialogues.jp:
柔らかくて……これが夢なんじゃないかって思
えて。
dialogues.en: It was so soft, and I kept wondering if it was just a dream.
dialogues.text: It was so soft, and I kept wondering if it was just a dream.

dialogues.jp: 長く長く、ずっと……。
dialogues.en: We craved each other for a long time.
dialogues.text: We craved each other for a long time.

dialogues.jp:
｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な身体を壊さないように――でも、強く抱
きしめる。
dialogues.en:
I held her tight, trying to be careful about not crushing
her tiny frame.
dialogues.text:
I held her tight, trying to be careful about not crushing
her tiny frame.

dialogues.jp: いとしくて、弱くて、大切なモノだから。
dialogues.en: She was the most important thing in my life.
dialogues.text: She was the most important thing in my life.

dialogues.jp: ……胸が痛い。

抱き寄せている音夢の胸から感じる鼓動も、信
じられないくらい速い。
dialogues.en: I felt her heart race really fast as well.
dialogues.text: I felt her heart race really fast as well.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が顔を離す。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……はぁ……ん……難しい」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「息止めてたのか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって」

軽くうつむいて、音夢が胸元で手をもじもじと
こする。
dialogues.en: Nemu crossed her hands looking down.
dialogues.text: Nemu crossed her hands looking down.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「嬉しいね……幸せすぎるよ……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "I'm so happy... I couldn't be happier... Niisan."
dialogues.text: "I'm so happy... I couldn't be happier... Niisan."

dialogues.jp: そっ、と。
羽のように。

どちらからともなくまた、ぎこちないまま、唇
を重ねる。
――ドクン
心臓が跳ねた。
視界が白く染まる。
ずるり、と寄りかかっていた重さがずれ落ちる。
dialogues.en: The weight of her body, leaning on me, shifted and dropped.
dialogues.text: The weight of her body, leaning on me, shifted and dropped.

dialogues.jp: 慌てて支えようとするが、腕に力が入らない。
dialogues.en:
I tried to support her but I have no strength to move my
arm.
dialogues.text:
I tried to support her but I have no strength to move my
arm.

dialogues.jp: なん……で……声も出せない？
dialogues.en: Why can't I even speak out?
dialogues.text: Why can't I even speak out?

dialogues.jp: 腕だけでなく全身の力が抜けていく。
dialogues.en:
Not only my arms, but the strength of my whole body is going
away.
dialogues.text:
Not only my arms, but the strength of my whole body is going
away.

dialogues.jp: 桜？
日向のような音夢の匂いに、桜の匂いがまじる。
dialogues.en:
The smell of cherry blossoms mixed with the smell of Nemu
like sunshine.
dialogues.text:
The smell of cherry blossoms mixed with the smell of Nemu
like sunshine.

dialogues.jp: 頭が……ふ……らふらする。
なんで――
◆子供っぽいキス◆

俺を避けていたはずの音夢とドラマを見る俺。
この状況がなんなのか見当がつかない。
dialogues.en:
I watched the soap opera with Nemu who'd been avoiding me
for a while. I have no idea what's going on between us.
dialogues.text:
I watched the soap opera with Nemu who'd been avoiding me
for a while. I have no idea what's going on between us.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか様子のおかしい音夢の顔を覗き込んだ
とき、音夢からキスをしてきた。
dialogues.en:
I looked at her face to find out what's wrong with her and
she kissed me.
dialogues.text:
I looked at her face to find out what's wrong with her and
she kissed me.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま抱き合い、キスを繰り返す音夢と俺だっ
たけど……急に胸が苦しくなり、ふたりとも意
識を失ってしまうのだった。
dialogues.en:
We held each other and kissed, but then I felt pain in my
chest and we both lost consciousness.
dialogues.text:
We held each other and kissed, but then I felt pain in my
chest and we both lost consciousness.
